import numpy as np

def qft(n):
    """
    Generates a Quantum Fourier Transform circuit for n qubits.
    """
    circuit = Circuit(n)
    for i in range(n):
        circuit.add(gates.H(i))
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            circuit.add(gates.CZ(i, j))
    # Swap the qubits to get the standard QFT order
    for i in range(n // 2):
        circuit.add(gates.SWAP(i, n - 1 - i))
    return circuit

# Visualize the circuit
